alternate_titles: Direttorio su pietà popolare e liturgia
work.author: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
work.description: The congregation's directory on the relation of popular piety to the liturgy. Paragraphs 213-217 treat devotion to the holy angels, its liturgical forms, and its deviations, including the direction that assigning names to the angels should be discouraged except for Gabriel, Raphael, and Michael, whose names Scripture contains. A locus is the paragraph number.
work.title: Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy: Principles and Guidelines
